audit_summary.summary: One high-severity ecommerce mapping concern detected. Unsafe ecommerce payload edits intentionally withheld; human analyst review and test purchase required.

findings.title: Purchase tag lacks explicit transaction ID, currency, and items mappings
findings.description: The exported GA4 purchase tag explicitly maps value but does not explicitly map transaction_id, currency, or items. The export cannot establish whether other implementation layers supply these fields or whether test purchases behave correctly.

evidence.observation: Tag 105 (GA4 - Event - purchase), type gaawe, has eventName=purchase, measurementId={{CONST - GA4 Measurement ID}}, and value={{DLV - ecommerce.value}}; its parameter array has no transaction_id, currency, or items keys.
Tag 105 fires on trigger ID 205 (CE - purchase), type CUSTOM_EVENT; the export does not include a custom-event filter/parameter proving the literal event match.
Variable 306 (DLV - ecommerce.value) points to dataLayer name ecommerce.value; no variables for ecommerce.transaction_id, ecommerce.currency, or ecommerce.items appear in this export.
Confirm the actual dataLayer purchase payload, mapping requirements, trigger matching, and event transmission in a controlled GTM Preview/test purchase; export-only inspection cannot verify them.

recommended_actions: Developer and analytics analyst should document observed purchase dataLayer keys and types for transaction_id, currency, value, and items, with transaction_id stable and unique per purchase.
After confirming source fields, manually configure and review the GA4 purchase tag mappings; do not invent dataLayer keys, constants, or currency defaults.
Test purchase event in GTM Preview and approved analytics debugging workflow for one firing, expected parameters, accurate totals, and no duplicate transactions.

manual_review_items.reason: Purchase transaction_id, currency, and items field sources are not established by the export; changing ecommerce payloads is blocked for automation.

assumptions: Fixture ID synthetic-ecommerce-001 is user-supplied, not a field in the source export.
Absence of explicit tag mappings does not prove absence of data in all runtime analytics paths.
